title: Lesson text file
description: The text of one lesson, a short conversation written by an AI and approved by the user. It holds no audio settings (speed, pauses); those live in the tuning file.

id.description: Lesson id, also the file name without .json.

target_lang.description: Language code of the language being learned (the sentences in `target`), for example fr.

meaning_lang.description: Language code of the explanation language (the sentences in `meaning`), for example en. Must differ from target_lang.

title.description: Short title of the lesson, written in the meaning language.

persona.description: Optional. First name of the made-up person the learner stands in for (speaker a, if the sentences have speakers).

speakers.description: Optional. The two roles of a conversation, written in the meaning language, for example a = Customer and b = Seller. Present if and only if the sentences have a `speaker`.

register.description: Optional. Level of politeness of the target language, for example vous or tu in French. Only for languages that have the distinction.

accent.description: Optional. Regional variety of the target language, for example France French.

sentences.description: The sentences of the lesson, in the order they are played.

id.description: Sentence id, unique in the lesson: s01, s02, ...

speaker.description: Optional. Who says the sentence: a or b, as named in `speakers`. Give it to every sentence or to none.

target.description: The sentence in the language being learned, as it is spoken.

meaning.description: The same sentence in the meaning language, natural rather than word for word.

phrases.description: Optional. A suggestion for splitting `target` at natural pauses. Joined together (ignoring spaces) the pieces must equal `target` exactly.
